10 ITI Student Handbook CODE OF CONDUCT & DRESS CODE All students are expected to maintain a respectful, responsible, and professional demeanor at all times. The following principles apply to both online and onsite settings: CONDUCT PRINCIPLES Show respect for instructors, staff, fellow students, and all ITI personnel. Maintain the integrity of facilities, equipment, and shared learning environments. Participate actively in lectures, discussions, and team activities. Follow ITI policies regarding academic honesty and constructive feedback. The institute maintains a zero-tolerance policy for misbehavior and abusive or offensive language. Disciplinary action may be taken for any behavior that disrupts the learning environment or tarnishes our values.
